S29.17.needs: a Free account or a paid account, and a workbook request
S29.17.note: No insert-chart control was found in apps/web or packages/ui. Charts come only from the workbook file builder (apps/web/lib/services/managed-workbook-builder.ts, a sheet's optional chart field, bar, line or pie), so the route is asking chat for an .xlsx file with a chart. The visible route and its download control were not verified.

S29.18.needs: a presentation with a chart (ask chat to make one)
S29.18.note: The selector is only in the deck chart editor; the spreadsheet artifact has no chart-type control in the files checked.
steps: Ask chat for a slide deck that includes a chart, then open the presentation artifact.
Click the Edit chart data button under the slide.
Open the Chart type selector and choose Line or Pie (Bar, Line and Pie are the options).
Click Apply.
Compare the chart on the slide with the chosen type.
S29.18.where: Presentation artifact > Edit chart data > Chart type

S29.19.note: The editor edits the chart's own rows and series values. No picker for a sheet cell range was found, so Expected's cell-range wording is only partly matched.
steps: Open a presentation artifact that has a chart.
Click Edit chart data.
Look at the Chart data table: one row per data point, one column per series.
Change a value in a cell, add or remove a row, then click Apply.
Compare the plotted values with the table.

S29.27.needs: a data file to upload, and an account that allows code execution (plan not verified)
S29.27.note: CodeExecutionBlock shows output and images. The Python source itself was not found in this component, so whether the code is visible was not verified.
steps: Attach a data file and ask chat to analyse it with Python and draw a chart.
Wait until a Code Execution block appears under the reply; it says Running Python… while it runs.
Click the Code Execution header to expand it.
Look for the Output label, any text output, and any chart image.
Compare with Expected: code, output and charts should all be visible.
S29.27.where: Chat > Code Execution block > click Code Execution to expand

S29.28.needs: none beyond a chat that returns a table
S29.28.note: Sorting is in the spreadsheet artifact. The text Sort by is the hover title of each heading button, not a visible label. Whether a query or analysis produces this table was not verified.
steps: Ask chat for a result as a table or spreadsheet, then open the table artifact.
Click a column heading.
Look for the arrow and the change in row order.
Click the same heading again and check that the order reverses.
Compare with Expected: the result table is sortable.
S29.28.where: Chat > table artifact > click a column heading to sort

S29.34.note: The web download menu offers only Download as CSV for tables. The Export as Excel item in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/ArtifactRenderer.tsx shows only when a host passes onExportNative, and apps/web does not use ArtifactRenderer. An .xlsx file can be requested from chat through the file tool in apps/web/lib/services/managed-office-file-service.ts, but its download control was not found.

S29.35.note: The menu item appears only for artifact types spreadsheet, table and csv.
steps: Open a spreadsheet or table artifact.
Click the download icon (its hidden name is Download artifact).
Click Download as CSV.
Open the saved .csv file.
Compare the rows and columns with the table on screen.
S29.35.where: Spreadsheet artifact > Download artifact > Download as CSV

S29.36.note: The PNG button has the hidden name Download <chart name> as PNG. Nothing in the chart export code produces a file other than PNG.
steps: Ask chat for a chart, then open the chart artifact.
Click the PNG button in the chart toolbar.
Open the saved .png file.
Compare the picture with the chart on screen.

S29.38.note: The menu items appear only for document artifacts that are not already PDF or DOCX. Whether an analysis turns into a document artifact was not verified.
steps: Ask chat to analyse the data and write a report, then open the document artifact.
Click the download icon (its hidden name is Download artifact).
Click Download as Word (.docx) or Download as PDF.
Open the saved file.
Compare its formatting with Expected: a formatted report.
S29.38.where: Document artifact > Download artifact > Download as Word (.docx)

S29.39.note: The presentation download menu offers Download as PDF only, in apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts/ArtifactPreview.tsx. No pptx download label was found. A .pptx file can be requested from chat through apps/web/lib/services/managed-office-file-service.ts, but its download control was not found.
